user.title: Connect SimpliFi
user.description: Start in the offline simulator, or connect locally with a dedicated UniFi API key. Management starts disabled. TLS verification stays on unless you explicitly choose otherwise.

scope.title: Select explicit managed scope
scope.description: Select the networks whose devices you want to manage. The built-in External internet zone is selected automatically. These settings do not modify the gateway.

reconfigure.title: Change UniFi connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the API key blank to keep it on the same controller. A new controller address requires a new key. The connection is checked before anything is saved.

data.api_key: New API key (optional on the same controller)

connection_scope.title: Review managed scope
connection_scope.description: Changing controller, site, scope or timezone requires management to be disabled and all owned policies cleaned up first. Credential-only changes retain policy ownership.

connection_mapping.title: Map network {position} of {total}
connection_mapping.description: Choose the destination for old network ID {source}. Network rules will use the selected destination. Device ownership will be matched again by MAC address.

connection_review.title: Confirm connection changes

data.confirm: Save this reviewed connection and reload the integration

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to UniFi
reauth_confirm.description: UniFi rejected the saved API key. Enter a valid key for the same controller and site. Your household settings and policy ownership will be retained.

error.cannot_connect: Connection, TLS, permission or API-version check failed. Check local diagnostics; no policy was written.
error.invalid_scope: Select a valid site, nonempty networks and destination zone.

abort.already_configured: This controller/site or simulator is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Gateway resources unavailable. No policy was written.
abort.simulator_reconfigure: The simulator has no live connection. Add a separate live entry to connect to UniFi.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Connection settings saved. The integration is reloading.
abort.reauth_successful: UniFi credentials updated. SimpliFi will reconnect automatically.

edit.title: {action}
edit.description:
{catalogue}

Existing group/rule IDs select an edit; empty IDs create a new object. Edits replace the submitted fields. Choose exactly one deadline mode.

data.name: Name
data.networks: Whole managed networks (choose groups or networks)
data.network_mapping: Source network ID to managed network ID (required for another controller/site/scope)

windows.title: Recurring windows
windows.description:
Current windows: {windows}
Weekdays name the day a window starts. Empty list means always-on.

window.title: Add a recurring window
window.description: Choose the weekdays on which this window starts. Set overnight explicitly when it crosses midnight.

targets.title: Choose restriction targets
targets.description: Search the full gateway catalogue, or add domain names without URLs or wildcards.

error.invalid_input: Invalid fields; check catalogue IDs, groups, windows and deadline mode.
error.change_failed: Change failed or configuration revision changed. Refresh the editor and review sync diagnostics.

abort.updates_managed_by_hacs: Manage SimpliFi releases in HACS, then restart Home Assistant when prompted. The dashboard card is included. SimpliFi does not need a GitHub token. If you installed manually, replace custom_components/simplifi with the new release and restart Home Assistant.

sync_failed.title: SimpliFi sync could not be confirmed
sync_failed.description: SimpliFi cannot currently confirm or update gateway policies. Saved settings and policy ownership are retained. Open the SimpliFi dashboard or download diagnostics for the specific reason. SimpliFi retries automatically. Existing gateway rules remain in place, but temporary allowances and pauses may outlast their deadlines while policy updates are paused.

inventory_scope_failed.title: SimpliFi device networks could not be confirmed
inventory_scope_failed.description: UniFi returned conflicting or incomplete device-network information, and one complete fresh read could not resolve it. Saved settings, assignments and ownership evidence were retained; this failed discovery made no policy writes. Inspect integration diagnostics for the discovery attempts. SimpliFi retries automatically and clears this warning after a complete confirmed sync.
